Locate the precompiled directory for the current platform

Source: R/stan_platform.R
dot-stan_precompiled_dir.Rd

Searches stan/precompiled/<key> inside the installed or source package (works for both devtools::load_all() and installed contexts because system.file() is overridden by pkgload in both cases).

Usage

.stan_precompiled_dir(platform_key)

Arguments

platform_key

Character scalar from .stan_platform_key().

Value

Absolute path to the directory, or "" if it does not exist.
